svg.title: Blue Panel
svg.desc: Interpretive vector after actual visual inspection. Approximate contours and interpretive screen colors. Individual Chicago component actually viewed in the museum public image preview and downloaded through the ordinary browser. Major corner/curve positions transcribed; wall and cast shadow omitted. Overall bounding aspect uses museum dimensions. Individual panels are distinct from the installation group. Palette refinement (2026-11-09): source review remains unresolved for blue; prior provisional screen colors retained, not calibrated to original paint.
svg.metadata: Reference: https://www.artic.edu/artworks/152760; inspected 2026-10-27; interpretive study, not a facsimile.
